title: Partner clips
description: animations/partner_clips.yaml of the game pack: the recipes that give the species models with only their scenes' few clips every clip the partner plays in the field and in battle (docs/modulos/engine/animation.md, «Clips de compañero»). Nothing of the disc is here: the clips are made when the partner's model loads, from the user's extracted models. A species' clips are retargeted from a donor (its clips moved through a bone map) or made from the model's own idle with a motion and timed by the donor's clip of the same id.

clips.description: The clip ids the partner's field and battle code play.

first_technique.description: The first technique clip id (one per move slot from it); every donor clip from it is made too.

motions.description: The made motion of each clip id, for the procedural recipes.

technique.description: The made motion of every technique clip.

kind.description: The shape of the motion: breathe, stride (a step cycle), bounce (hops), shake (side to side), nod (eating), lie (onto its side), squat, droop, guard, recoil (a blow), fall, rise, lunge (wind-up, blow, back).

beats.description: How many cycles the clip has.

angle.description: Degrees of the swing, bend or turn.

height.description: The lift or drop, a fraction of the hips' height.

lean.description: A held bend of the body over the whole clip, degrees forward (+) or back (-).

strike.description: Lunge: the part of the clip at which the blow lands.

from_behind.description: Recoil: the blow comes from behind.

donor.description: The species whose clips are moved over or time the made ones.

bones.description: 'same' (the same hierarchy) or joint of this model -> joint of the donor.

keep.description: Clip ids of its own the partner keeps.

groups.description: The joints the made motions move; a procedural recipe needs them (the loader checks).

upright.description: The body never leans forward or back: a motion's lean moves it forward or back instead.

spin.description: Joints that turn on their own all the time.

motions.description: Motions of this species that replace the book's.
